study type: Mixed methods quasi-experimental study with a before-after interventional design
outcome: Testing for four conditions by four months of pregnancy
cohort: The study participants included pregnant mothers, community health volunteers, facility staff, and senior county health officials in Migori county, western Kenya, with quantitative data from 707 baseline and 894 endline unique ANC attendances.
finding: The 4byFour community-facility health system strengthening model led to a significant 26% increase in overall ANC uptake and an improvement in early ANC attendance from 22% to 33%.
